changelog:
- Initial release of agent-orchestrator meta-agent skill.
- Orchestrates complex tasks by decomposing them into autonomous sub-agents using dynamically generated SKILL.md files.
- Coordinates file-based communication, progress monitoring, and consolidation of results among specialized agents.
- Includes detailed workflow for task breakdown, agent generation, dispatch, monitoring, and dissolution.
- Provides built-in sub-agent templates and support for AI capabilities via SkillBoss API Hub integration.
